queries.name: top customers by sales
queries.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

queries.name: top customer sales by region
queries.sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT :limit_val;
